fields.value: MOESM3 of Histological, immunohistochemical and mRNA gene expression responses in coeliac disease patients challenged with gluten using PAXgene fixed paraffin-embedded duodenal biopsies

dsDescriptionValue.value: Additional file 3: Figure S1. Immunohistochemical stainings in PAXgene fixed specimens. CD3 (A) and CD8 staining (B) of PAXgene-fixed specimens for analysis of CD3+CD8− lymphocytes in the diagnosis of refractory coeliac disease. Small intestine mucosal immunoglobulin (Ig) A deposits in duodenal specimens in a coeliac disease patient are also shown. First was normal haematoxylin and eosin staining (C), followed by IgA staining (green (D)) and transglutaminase 2 (TG2) (red (E)). The subepithelial colocalization of IgA and TG2 can be seen in yellow (F).
